name: COMP_060
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (76%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs InSitu · Careful review
Both classes share the 90% conformal set [F1].

## Confidence

| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 76%, Benign 22% | Clear lead, not decisive |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu | Two classes unseparated |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.94 / 84th percentile | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 1 of 5 InSitu [F5] | Neighbors mostly Benign |

## Tissue evidence

- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 3, 4, 5) · ↓ invasive · Fits in situ, not invasive, growth · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 2, 10) · ↓ invasive · Gland-forming tissue lowers invasive association · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · Atypia present; small invasive association · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 4, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · Scored high but failed spot check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 0, 1, 9) · context · Descriptive only; spot check borderline · Weak

## Trust check

- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cut the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier; necrosis and mitoses are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if

- Benign and InSitu overlap; nearest neighbors lean Benign (4 of 5).
- Reliability score only moderately flags errors (AUROC 0.69, small test set).

## Check on the slide

1. **Regions 3, 4, 5:** confirm atypical cells stay within ducts; no stromal breach.
2. **Regions 4, 5, 9:** look for true necrosis; the automated score failed its spot check.
3. **Regions 1, 5, 9:** assess nuclear atypia and mitoses directly.
